ideas.name: Birlasoft Ltd
ideas.why: Birlasoft is a mid-tier global IT services and consulting company, part of the CK Birla Group, with deep enterprise-application expertise across SAP and Oracle alongside growing digital, cloud and AI capabilities. The company is undergoing a strategic transformation under new leadership, with fresh senior hires and a sharp build-out of sales capacity aimed at reviving growth and sharpening execution. While near-term demand remains soft, an AI-first pivot toward outcome-based deals and a focus on deepening key client relationships position it for a gradual recovery over the medium term.

ideas.name: Indian Hotels Co
ideas.why: India's largest hospitality company, with a diversified brand portfolio spanning the luxury Taj franchise through to mid-market and budget formats — the breadth means it captures demand across the entire travel cycle. The signed pipeline nearly doubles the existing portfolio over the next few years, and critically much of it is asset-light managed inventory, where management fees are a high-margin annuity stream that keeps lifting return ratios without consuming capital. Room rates and occupancy both continue to climb, evidence of genuine pricing power from brand strength and disciplined room addition rather than volume-led growth. A substantial net cash position funds the entire pipeline without straining the balance sheet, and the proposed merger of Oriental Hotels adds properties in South India while simplifying the group structure. The chart shows a sustained breakout holding firm through broader market consolidation — relative strength that argues the uptrend is resuming.

ideas.name: IDFC First Bank
ideas.why: The liability franchise is the core of the story — a rising share of low-cost current and savings deposits alongside a falling cost of funds, lifting margins and letting management upgrade its guidance rather than defend it. Retail now forms the bulk of funded assets, with broad-based loan growth across mortgages, vehicles, consumer, small business and corporate. The microfinance stress that disrupted earnings has largely passed: bad loans have improved, slippages are down sharply, credit cost guidance has been lowered, and most of that portfolio sits under credit guarantee cover. Operating leverage is coming through, with the cost-to-income ratio falling and profit growth far outpacing expenses — and the bank still set aside a contingency buffer against macro and monsoon risks. Return on assets is on a clear path higher, arriving earlier than previously expected, with a steep earnings ramp modelled over the next two years. Technically, the stock has broken out of a near two-year consolidation on strong volume.

ideas.name: Tech Mahindra
ideas.why: Tech Mahindra is a global consulting and systems integration company operating across more than 90 countries, blending digital innovation with deep industry expertise. Its turnaround is now broad-based, with every revenue vertical growing simultaneously and larger client relationships expanding, removing reliance on any single engine of growth. AI is proving to be both a revenue and margin lever as lower-value legacy work gives way to stickier, higher-value engagements, while multiple productivity levers leave a meaningful runway for further margin expansion.

ideas.name: TCS
ideas.why: TCS is India's largest IT services and consulting company, serving global enterprises across banking, retail, manufacturing, healthcare and other industries in over 50 countries. Rising enterprise spending on artificial intelligence is emerging as a key growth driver, backed by a strong AI services pipeline, large multi-year deal wins and a healthy overall order book that lends good revenue visibility. With resilient margins, robust cash generation and a deep, diversified client base, the company remains well placed to benefit from the next leg of digital and AI-led transformation.

ideas.name: One 97
ideas.why: Paytm is one of India's leading digital-payments and financial-services platforms, spanning merchant and consumer payments alongside distribution of lending, broking and wealth products. India's digital-payments ecosystem offers a large runway, with rising merchant adoption, expanding use cases and low penetration in digital lending giving the company substantial room to scale. Its large two-sided merchant and consumer network allows payment volumes to scale while monetisation improves through financial-services distribution and value-added offerings. Profitability has turned the corner, with revenue growth outpacing indirect costs and operating leverage supporting sustained margin expansion and free-cash-flow generation, aided by an AI-led operating model and a strong cash balance. Digital lending remains a key earnings driver, with a merchant-focused, partner-distributed model supported by data-led underwriting and disciplined borrower selection.

ideas.name: Caplin Point Lab
ideas.why: A fully integrated pharma company that has quietly compounded revenue and profit at a high rate over several years — the track record itself is the core of the thesis. Its stronghold is emerging markets across Latin America and Africa, where a direct distribution model gives it pricing power and stickiness, while the regulated-market push into the US through its sterile injectables arms opens a much larger addressable opportunity. The latest quarter continued the pattern: healthy topline growth with margins expanding rather than being bought with discounts. The balance sheet is a genuine differentiator — low debt, strong return ratios and steady promoter holding, with institutional participation inching up. Technically, the stock is in a clean higher-top-higher-bottom uptrend and has broken out of consolidation on heavy volume, with cup-and-handle and flag patterns lining up across timeframes.

ideas.name: Max Healthcare
ideas.why: Max Healthcare is one of India's leading private healthcare providers, with a strong North India network spanning multi-specialty hospitals, diagnostics through Max Lab and home healthcare through Max@Home. The growth driver is capacity expansion — significant brownfield capacity already commissioned, along with the new Gurgaon hospital, upcoming Lucknow projects and the Kalinga Hospital acquisition, which marks its entry into Eastern India. Occupancy has stayed healthy even while adding beds, so operating leverage should improve as newly commissioned hospitals ramp up through FY27. CGHS rate revisions have started benefiting earnings, with further benefit expected in the coming months. Technically, a confirmed double bottom breakout is now retesting its breakout zone, with momentum turning higher and a higher top–higher bottom structure intact, keeping the setup constructive.

ideas.name: FSN E-Commerce
ideas.why: Nykaa is delivering broad-based revenue growth across beauty and fashion segments, with strong momentum in customer acquisition and repeat purchases supporting sustained expansion. The company has achieved a structural profitability inflection with margin expansion and disciplined cost management, signaling a re-rating story with improving return profile and capital efficiency. Retail expansion with exclusive global brand partnerships is positioning Nykaa as the preferred launch platform for beauty brands in India, supporting long-term store growth and category penetration into new geographies. Technically, the stock has decisively broken above a multi-year resistance level with momentum confirmation, marking a meaningful shift in chart structure and opening room for extended upside.

ideas.name: Finolex Cables
ideas.why:
Finolex Cables Limited remains well positioned to benefit from strong structural tailwinds across power infrastructure, EVs, renewable energy, telecom and data centre investments. While the core Wires & Cables business continues to witness healthy demand across power, automotive and solar segments, the Optical Fibre Cable (OFC) business could emerge as a key growth driver over the medium term, supported by sharp improvement in global OFC pricing, tightening fibre supply and rising demand from AI-led infrastructure and data centres. Ongoing fibre and preform capacity expansion, improving utilisation levels and operating leverage are expected to support meaningful margin expansion in the OFC segment, while
rapid scaling in solar cables further strengthens the company’s growth outlook.

ideas.name: ACME Solar Hold.
ideas.why: One of India's largest renewable IPPs, with revenue locked into long-dated power purchase agreements with government-backed offtakers at fixed tariffs — a highly visible, annuity-like cashflow base. Battery storage is the real story: capacity has scaled rapidly at margins well above conventional renewables, management has pulled its storage target forward, and this is emerging as the key earnings driver. The growth pipeline is largely de-risked, with most under-construction capacity already tied to signed PPAs, debt lined up and transmission connectivity secured, supporting a multi-year capacity ramp toward its 2030 ambitions. Operating performance is at record levels on better irradiation, high plant availability and strong grid uptime, and estimates have been revised upward on the back of it. Technically, the stock is in a clean higher-top-higher-bottom uptrend and has just broken out of a month-long consolidation on a surge in volume.

ideas.name: Sonata Software
ideas.why: Sonata Software is rated a BUY with an attractive risk-reward over a 0–3 month horizon. It's a turnaround finding its footing: despite a soft topline last quarter, profitability improved on a better offshore mix, higher utilisation and pyramid optimisation. The forward driver is AI — a sharply expanded AI-led pipeline now forming a growing share of the order book, supported by two large deal wins, seven new customers, the Harmoni.AI framework and a deep Microsoft partnership. Management expects the weak domestic business to normalise within a quarter or two, removing the main drag. Technically, the stock has bounced off long-term support with momentum recovering from oversold levels and volumes improving. The caveats: revenue is still declining and the thesis depends on that domestic recovery landing on time — this is a bounce trade, not an established uptrend.

ideas.name: Kalpataru Proj.
ideas.why: Diversified EPC/infrastructure player (power transmission, buildings, water, railways, oil & gas) with a large, growing order book and widening overseas presence. On the weekly chart it's respecting a rising trendline, holding RSI momentum, and breaking out of a multi-year resistance with a strong candle after a long consolidation. Improving execution and margins, plus a stronger balance sheet, back the move fundamentally. Well placed to ride India's infrastructure and power-capex upcycle, with a defined stop capping downside over a 1–3 month horizon.

ideas.name: L&T Finance Ltd
ideas.why: L&T Finance is transitioning from wholesale to a retail-led lending franchise, backed by the Larsen & Toubro Group's parentage. Its AI-driven underwriting push via Project Cyclops is improving credit assessment and collections efficiency. The stock is also consolidating in a bullish ascending triangle near key resistance, pointing to a possible breakout.

ideas.name: City Union Bank
ideas.why: Asset quality is continuously improving while margins remain stable, supporting strong earnings expansion with double-digit profit growth visibility. The bank is accelerating branch expansion across India to deepen customer reach, supported by smooth leadership transition ensuring strategic continuity. Technically, the stock is testing a critical historical breakout zone with bullish momentum indicators confirming a potential breakout to higher targets.

ideas.name: Eternal
ideas.why: Eternal is executing a successful quick commerce scale-up with a structural runway for growth, rapidly expanding its dark store network and penetrating beyond key metros with deepening category adoption. The company is approaching profitability as operating leverage kicks in across larger cities, with management targeting steady-state EBITDA margins and significant profit growth visibility over the medium term. Food delivery recovery provides a second diversified growth engine, driven by improved unit economics and customer traction at lower membership thresholds. Technically, the stock has staged a steady recovery from support levels and is now retesting a critical multi-year resistance zone with volume confirmation, signaling potential for a structural breakout and fresh upside.

ideas.name: United Spirits
ideas.why:
Buy with USL remains a strong play on the accelerating premiumisation trend in India’s alcoholic beverages (alcobev) market, given its leadership in the premium and luxury segments and its expanding share in the mid- and upper-prestige categories. In the near term, earnings may face pressure due to the recent excise duty hike in Maharashtra key state contributing a mid-to-highteen share of NSV and the impact of a high base from 2HFY26 as Andhra Pradesh re-enters the market. However, FY27 is expected to benefit from potential tailwinds, including the likely
reduction in duties on bulk Scotch and BIO brands under the upcoming UK–India FTA. Management remains confident of sustaining double-digit growth in the Prestige & Above (P&A) segment, driven by ongoing premiumisation and an improving product mix.

ideas.name: Cyient
ideas.why: Transportation & Mobility has now strung together several consecutive quarters of growth, powered by aerospace, rail and automotive demand — the clearest engine in the portfolio. Order intake is rising and a sizeable qualified large-deal pipeline sits behind it, giving credible growth visibility as discretionary technology spending recovers. Profitability has improved sharply on cost optimisation and currency tailwinds, with margins expanding meaningfully even as the core design and engineering business stays soft on weak strategic units and delayed client spending. The TAO Digital acquisition and semiconductor investments are widening capability into AI, data engineering and next-generation technology services. Technically, the stock has broken out of a prolonged consolidation on strong volume with momentum shifting into a bullish range — a business turning the corner just as the chart confirms it.

ideas.name: Balrampur Chini
ideas.why: Balrampur Chini Mills is one of India's leading integrated sugar manufacturers, with operations spanning sugar, ethanol, industrial alcohol and cogeneration across its Uttar Pradesh facilities. The integrated model allows efficient value extraction from sugarcane while reducing dependence on any single revenue stream. Its Polylactic Acid project offers exposure to the fast-growing biodegradable plastics market, with commercialization progressing well on customer engagement, product qualification and supportive government policy, aided by structural cost advantages from captive sugar and bagasse. The industry backdrop is supportive, with domestic sugar inventories at historically low levels and expected ethanol pricing revisions and higher blending initiatives aiding medium-term profitability. Technically, a descending triangle breakout on the monthly chart signals resumption of the long-term uptrend, supported by a higher top–higher bottom structure and constructive volumes indicating sustained accumulation.

ideas.name: M & M Fin. Serv.
ideas.why: M&M Financial Services is rated a BUY because its earnings recovery is now visible rather than merely hoped-for: profit rose sharply year-on-year and, unusually, grew sequentially in a quarter that historically weakens — a sign the seasonality that long dogged the business is fading. Asset quality has improved to multi-year lows following a deliberate shift toward higher-grade rural-affluent and semi-urban borrowers, while cost ratios have reached their best levels in years on AI- and Udaan-driven productivity gains. Growth is coming from both engines, with the core vehicle book still gaining share in tractors and passenger vehicles while non-wheels lending in SME and mortgages scales rapidly, all within a sector seeing strong secured-credit demand. Backed by the Mahindra brand, a top credit rating and deep rural distribution, and trading at a modest book-value multiple relative to its larger peer, the mix of faster loan growth, better asset quality and operating leverage supports its return-on-assets ambition and sustained book-value accretion — though NBFC funding dependence and rural cash-flow sensitivity remain real risks, and the report itself contains a few inconsistencies worth verifying. This summarises one broker's thesis; I'm not a financial advisor.

ideas.name: LG Electronics
ideas.why: We recommend a Buy on LG India as strong brand position in consumer home and kitchen appliances, healthy demand in home appliances, decent market share, earnings  expected to grow steadily going forward as recovery in operating profit margin driven by increased domestic sourcing of components, a focus on B2B and export markets

ideas.name: Alkem Lab
ideas.why: Alkem Laboratories is one of India's leading pharma companies, with a strong domestic branded generics franchise across acute and chronic therapies. The domestic business continues to outperform the broader Indian Pharmaceutical Market, with the chronic portfolio accelerating on new launches and an encouraging early response to its semaglutide commercialization. International operations delivered strong growth, while newer engines in MedTech, biosimilars and CDMO are diversifying the revenue base. Profitability is improving on a better product mix, operating leverage and disciplined cost control. Technically, after consolidating for over two years, the stock has delivered a multi-pattern breakout backed by strong volumes and bullish momentum, signalling the start of a fresh uptrend.

ideas.name: Jubilant Food.
ideas.why: Jubilant FoodWorks is the master franchisee behind Domino's Pizza across India and neighbouring markets, and also runs Dunkin' and the fast-growing Popeyes brand. Its delivery-led model continues to gain market share, helped by a lower minimum order value and a shift toward smaller, capital-efficient store formats. Premium product launches and the scale-up of Popeyes add fresh growth drivers, positioning the company to strengthen margins and unit economics over the medium term.

ideas.name: Eternal
ideas.why:
BUY Eternal with a target price of INR 377, implying meaningful upside from current levels.
The company is well-positioned to benefit from the structural growth in India’s hyperlocal
delivery ecosystem. While food delivery provides a stable, cash-generating base with
steady growth, quick commerce is emerging as the key incremental growth driver with
improving unit economics and a clear path to profitability

ideas.name: Hero Motocorp
ideas.why:
Hero MotoCorp has been forming a strong base around the 89-week EMA, which also coincides with the 50% Fibonacci retracement of the entire rally from the Year 2025 low, highlighting a key long-term support zone.
•	After consolidating at these support levels, the stock has witnessed a Symmetrical Triangle breakout on the daily chart, indicating the resumption of the prevailing uptrend.
•	On the momentum front, the Daily RSI formed a base near the 35 level and has now broken above the 60 mark, signalling strengthening momentum and increasing buying interest.
•	The stock has also reclaimed the 50-day EMA after an extended period, reinforcing the improvement in the short-term trend.

ideas.name: M & M Fin. Serv.
ideas.why: M&M Finance is driving sustained AUM growth across its diversified lending franchise spanning vehicle finance, MSME lending and mortgages, with management backing strong medium-term expansion aspiration. Asset quality is normalizing with improving collections and portfolio performance, while the macro-prudential overlay provides a potential upside tailwind if risks don't materialize. Profitability is surging on improved portfolio mix and operational efficiency, with stable credit cost guidance supporting earnings visibility. Technically, the stock is testing a critical historical support zone after correcting from all-time highs, with momentum cooling but maintaining constructive structure—presenting an attractive risk-reward setup for entry.

ideas.name: Angel One
ideas.why: Angel One is a leading fintech-enabled retail broking platform with a large, expanding client franchise, now diversifying into wealth management, distribution, and credit to reduce reliance on broking income. Heavy AI-led investment is driving operational efficiency across its digital ecosystem. Technically, the stock has confirmed a breakout above key resistance, with strengthening momentum supporting the bullish outlook.

ideas.name: Sun Pharma.Inds.
ideas.why: Sun Pharma is shifting from generics to higher-margin specialty products (Ilumya, Winlevi, Cequa), with revenue growing to an estimated ₹58,220 Cr (FY26) and a strong, low-leverage balance sheet. Technically, it has broken out above a key resistance zone on strong volume, now acting as support, supported by a positive pharma sector tailwind.

ideas.name: One 97
ideas.why:
BUY Paytm with a target price of INR 1,486, implying meaningful upside from current levels.
The company is well-positioned to benefit from the structural growth in India’s digital
payments and fintech ecosystem. While the payments business provides scale and
engagement with steady monetization, financial services is emerging as the key incremental
growth driver with improving margins and strong cross-sell opportunities

ideas.name: Birlasoft Ltd
ideas.why: Mid-cap IT services company (CK Birla Group), corrected meaningfully from its highs to a reasonable valuation. RSI is turning up and MACD is narrowing, with multiple support holding near the lows. A debt-light, cash-generative business with a recovering setup offers favourable risk-reward over a short horizon, with a defined stop capping downside. Note: still below its key moving averages, so an early-reversal bet rather than a confirmed uptrend.

ideas.name: Aurobindo Pharma
ideas.why: Aurobindo Pharma is one of India's largest, most diversified pharma companies, spanning generics, APIs, and formulations across the US, Europe, and emerging markets. Its vertically integrated API base gives it a structural cost edge and healthy margins, while a steady stream of USFDA approvals and a push into biosimilars and injectables add higher-margin growth optionality. Technically it's in a clean daily uptrend of higher highs and higher lows, holding a resistance-turned-support flip that lines up with the weekly trendline, and RSI is staying above 60 — sustained momentum. A risk-defined entry just above that support confluence, with a stop below the structure, gives a well-timed way into a fundamentally sound, well-positioned business.

ideas.name: Natl. Aluminium
ideas.why: NALCO offers an attractive investment opportunity with an estimated upside of around 20%, supported by both strong technical and fundamental factors. The stock is holding a key support zone near ₹375–380, while its long-term uptrend remains intact. Fundamentally, NALCO benefits from its integrated aluminium operations, low-cost production structure, strong balance sheet, and growth prospects driven by capacity expansion and rising demand from infrastructure, renewable energy, and electric vehicle sectors.

ideas.name: Power Fin.Corpn.
ideas.why: We recommend a Buy on Power Finance Corporation as strategic focus on green energy, opportunities in distribution and transmission, strong government support and improved asset quality.

ideas.name: Coforge
ideas.why: We recommend a Buy on Coforge Limited given it is well positioned to benefit from its underlying deal win momentum, healthy growth visibility, steady operating performance and eps accretive acquisition.

ideas.name: Coforge
ideas.why: Beyond the technical setup, Coforge's underlying business profile supports the constructive view. The company has been steadily expanding its presence in digital transformation, cloud, and AI-led services, helping it win larger and longer-duration client engagements across key global markets. Its client mix is increasingly diversified across sectors such as banking, travel, insurance, and healthcare, which reduces dependence on any single industry vertical. A consistent focus on deal wins, healthy order book visibility, and disciplined cost management has supported steady margin performance even as the company continues to invest in talent and capability building. Management's continued emphasis on expanding annuity-style, recurring revenue engagements adds further visibility to medium-term growth, suggesting the current price strength is supported by genuine business momentum rather than speculative positioning alone.

ideas.name: Tata Motors
ideas.why: We recommend a Buy on Tata Motors Limited given it is well positioned to benefit from its leadership in the CV space as recovery in CV cycle, a stronger global platform through acquisition of IVECO expands TAM with >₹2tn revenue scale, and margin improvement.

ideas.name: Varroc Engineer
ideas.why:
BUY with strong growth visibility. Varroc offers a compelling recovery and growth story
backed by rising LED penetration, an expanding global OEM base, and improving financial
health. Its diversified, powertrain-agnostic portfolio positions it well amid the EV transition,
while continued focus on premium products and margin expansion provides long-term value
creation potential. Execution on scaling and profitability remains the key monitorable.

ideas.name: Exide Inds.
ideas.why:
BUY with long-term growth potential. Exide’s dominant position in the auto battery market,
combined with its early foray into lithium-ion manufacturing, positions it well to benefit from
the shift towards EVs and energy storage. Strong industrial demand from UPS and telecom, coupled with a healthy balance sheet and favorable industry tailwinds, provide multiple levers for sustained growth.

ideas.name: City Union Bank
ideas.why:
BUY with steady long-term compounding potential. City Union Bank’s robust liability
franchise, marked by a highly granular deposit base and superior asset-liability
management, underpins balance sheet stability. The bank’s consistent cost efficiency (C/I
ratio at ~40–43%) rivals larger peers, while its niche SME/MSME focus drives strong riskadjusted spreads above 3%. With a conservative underwriting culture, collateral-backed
exposures, and sub-1.5% credit costs over the past five years, CUB stands out as a
disciplined, high-quality mid-sized lender positioned for sustainable profitability and
compounding growth.

ideas.name: PNB Housing
ideas.why: BUY with long-term growth visibility. PNB Housing Finance is repositioning its business toward a more granular and retail-driven loan book, supported by a growing presence in affordable housing. The shift toward salaried, better-profile customers and steady branch expansion should drive consistent, high-quality growth. With retail disbursements expected to accelerate and the affordable segment offering superior yields, PNBHF is well-placed to deliver sustained improvement in profitability and asset quality.

ideas.name: Syngene Intl.
ideas.why: BUY with a long growth runway. Syngene offers a structural growth story in the global CRO and CMO space, underpinned by strong client relationships and expanding capabilities. Its leadership in discovery services, trusted partnerships with global pharma majors, and entry into contract manufacturing position it well to capture the large outsourcing opportunity. Execution on scaling its integrated model remains the key driver of sustained value creation.

ideas.name: SBI
ideas.why: BUY with sustained earnings recovery potential. SBI’s dominant position in India’s banking sector, easing asset quality pressures, and diversified loan portfolio provide a strong foundation for growth. Core earnings are set to improve on the back of loan growth, margin expansion, and operating leverage, while its robust capital position, stable liability franchise, and digital leadership add further resilience. Multiple structural drivers support a sustained rerating over the medium to long term.

ideas.name: Sunteck Realty
ideas.why: BUY with strong growth visibility. Sunteck Realty offers a structural growth story driven by its asset-light development model and disciplined capital allocation. The company’s deep presence across key MMR micro-markets, robust launch pipeline, and strong balance sheet provide multi-year visibility on pre-sales growth and cash flow generation. Execution on upcoming launches and continued traction in premium housing remain key catalysts for value creation.
